items.source: This method accepts AntPathMatcher patterns.
items.translation: 此方法接受 `AntPathMatcher` 模式。

items.source: The XPath expression can be a parameterized string using formatting specifiers as defined in String.format(String, Object...).
items.translation: XPath 表达式可以是使用 String.format(String, Object...) 中定义的格式说明符进行参数化的字符串。

items.source: This method accepts only exact matches.
items.translation: 此方法仅接受精确匹配。

items.source: This method accepts exact matches against the expanded and encoded URL template.
items.translation: 此方法接受与扩展并编码后的 URL 模板的精确匹配。

items.source: expectedUrl - the exact URL expected
items.translation: expectedUrl - 预期的确切 URL

items.source: urlTemplate - a URL template; the expanded URL will be encoded
items.translation: urlTemplate - URL 模板；展开后的 URL 将进行编码。

items.source: uriVars - zero or more URI variables to populate the template
items.translation: uriVars - 零个或多个用于填充模板的 URI 变量

items.source: urlPattern - an Ant-style path pattern to match against
items.translation: urlPattern - 用于匹配的 Ant 风格路径模式

items.source: expression - the XPath expression, optionally parameterized with arguments
items.translation: expression - XPath 表达式，可选地带有参数。

items.source: The JSON path expression can be a parameterized string using formatting specifiers as defined in String.format(String, Object...).
items.translation: JSON 路径表达式可以是使用在String.format(String, Object...)中定义的格式化占位符的参数化字符串。

items.source: Evaluate the given JsonPath expression against the response body and assert the resulting value with the given Hamcrest Matcher.
items.translation: 评估给定的JsonPath表达式与响应体，并使用给定的 Hamcrest Matcher断言结果值。

items.source: Access to response body assertions.
items.translation: 访问响应体断言。

items.source: Access to response cookie assertions.
items.translation: 访问响应 Cookie 断言。

items.source: Access to flash attribute assertions.
items.translation: 访问闪存属性断言。

items.source: Asserts the request was forwarded to the given URL.
items.translation: 断言请求已转发到给定的 URL。

items.source: Access to assertions for the handler that handled the request.
items.translation: 可访问用于处理该请求的处理器中的断言。

items.source: Access to response header assertions.
items.translation: 访问响应头断言。

items.source: Access to model-related assertions.
items.translation: 访问与模型相关的断言。

items.source: Asserts the request was redirected to the given URL.
items.translation: 断言请求被重定向到了给定的 URL。

items.source: Access to request-related assertions.
items.translation: 访问与请求相关的断言。

items.source: Access to response status assertions.
items.translation: 响应状态断言的访问权限。

items.source: Access to assertions on the selected view.
items.translation: 对选定视图的断言访问。

items.source:
Access to response body assertions using an XPath expression to
inspect a specific subset of the body.
items.translation: 使用 XPath 表达式访问响应体断言，以检查响应体的特定子集。

items.source: expression - the JSON path expression, optionally parameterized with arguments
items.translation: expression - 可选地带有参数的 JSON 路径表达式

items.source: expression - the JSON path expression
items.translation: expression - JSON 路径表达式

items.source: matcher - a matcher for the value expected at the JSON path
items.translation: matcher - 用于匹配 JSON 路径预期值的匹配器

items.source: targetType - the target type to coerce the matching value into
items.translation: targetType - 要将匹配的值强制转换为此目标类型

items.source: args - arguments to parameterize the XPath expression with
items.translation: args - 用于参数化 XPath 表达式的参数

items.source:
Consider adding this class as a Java editor favorite. To navigate to
this setting, open the Preferences and type "favorites".
items.translation: 考虑将此类添加为 Java 编辑器收藏夹。要导航到该设置，请打开首选项并输入"favorites"。

items.source:
This can be useful for matching numbers reliably — for example,
to coerce an integer into a double.
items.translation: 这可用于可靠地匹配数字——例如，将整数强制转换为双精度浮点数。

items.source: Evaluate the given JsonPath expression against the response body and assert the resulting value with the given Hamcrest Matcher, coercing the resulting value into the given target type before applying the matcher.
items.translation: 评估给定的 JsonPath 表达式与响应体，并使用给定的 Hamcrest Matcher 断言结果值，在应用匹配器之前将结果值强制转换为给定的目标类型。

items.source: Access to response body assertions using a JsonPath expression to inspect a specific subset of the body.
items.translation: 使用 JsonPath 表达式访问响应体断言，以检查特定子集。

items.source: Asserts the request was forwarded to the given URL template.
items.translation: 断言请求已转发到给定的 URL 模板。

items.source: Asserts the request was redirected to the given URL template.
items.translation: 断言请求被重定向到了给定的 URL 模板。

items.source: args - arguments to parameterize the JSON path expression with
items.translation: args - 用于参数化 JSON 路径表达式的参数

items.source: namespaces - the namespaces referenced in the XPath expression
items.translation: namespaces - XPath 表达式中引用的命名空间
